## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** op=use builds sd2_<slug> and @launches it on the session's node; no in-session swap

**Pick whip: none.** op=use takes a wrestler name (default The Rock); no RAM identification of the wrestlers in the ring; generic pick_identify slot guess only

**Live controls:** none
